title: Service the clutch hydraulics
completeness: Complete hydraulic-circuit service using a new master-cylinder kit and a complete replacement release cylinder, with both hose ends disconnected, cleaned and refilled. Does not rebuild release-cylinder internals or service clutch plates.
entry_state: Assembled exact US2026 stock YZ450F; engine stopped and cool.
Serviceable mechanical clutch, pushrod and engine-side oil seal; exact master kit and complete replacement release cylinder available.
exit_state: Master kit renewed; replacement release cylinder fitted with new mounting seal; circuit cleaned and connected.
Clutch fluid at its baseline, circuit bled and closed, lever/routing/operation checked.

source.review_note: Visual252/253/101 and prior approved release access254/257. Entire circuit disconnected/cleaned as261, complete release replacement because262–263 contains no internal rebuild. DOT4 level is clutch baseline100, not brake minimum. Kit orientation requires original253 diagram. Independent reviewer yamaha_workshop_evidence approved all 15 steps against visual PDF100/252/253/257/262/263 and text99–101/252–254/257/261–263, plus inherited release closure. Required printed-page metadata correction applied; no mechanical content changed.

applicability.included: Stock hydraulic clutch on exact US2026 YZ450F
excluded: Other years and aftermarket hydraulic systems
Mechanical clutch plates or pushrod/oil-seal repair

required_tools.name: Stable stand, clean containers, hand and retaining-ring tools
Clear bleed hose and waste container

required_parts.name: Exact new clutch master-cylinder kit
required_parts.purpose: Diagram253 kit including new piston seals

required_parts.name: Complete exact stock replacement release cylinder
required_parts.purpose: Assembly replacement; no internal rebuild instructions asserted

required_parts.name: Four new copper hose union washers
required_parts.purpose: Two at each disconnected hose end

required_parts.name: Fresh DOT4 clutch fluid
required_parts.purpose: Clean, lubricate and refill entire hydraulic circuit

required_parts.name: Silicone grease
required_parts.purpose: Source-marked master pushrod/lever and release mounting seal/contact

required_parts.name: LOCTITE locking agent
required_parts.purpose: Release mounting bolts; OEM does not specify product grade

preflight: Yamaha recommends renewing friction and clutch plates when changing clutch fluid; plate service is a separate operation.
Protect surfaces/eyes; do not operate clutch with release unit unbolted.
critical_stop_conditions: Mechanical clutch wear/fault outside hydraulic scope.
Damaged master/hose, uncertain kit orientation or unseated retention.
Persistent leak, soft lever or abnormal clutch operation.

steps.title: Prepare hydraulic service
steps.instruction: Stop/cool engine and support bike on level ground. Clean release-cylinder area and protect surfaces. Check fluid at horizontal master: above baseline requires friction-plate wear inspection, below baseline requires leak inspection before treating this as hydraulic-only work.
steps.verification: Mechanical clutch serviceable; fluid history and visible defects recorded.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Drain entire circuit
steps.instruction: Remove master cap and diaphragm. Put hose/container on release bleeder and drain fluid with clutch lever/bleeder cycle. Disconnect both hose unions and discard all four copper washers, catching residual fluid.
steps.verification: Entire circuit drained; no old fluid reused.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove release cylinder
steps.instruction: Remove drive-sprocket cover and its two bolts. Unbolt and withdraw release cylinder while retaining interface washer. Leave engine pushrod and its oil seal installed; prevent lever operation with unit off.
steps.verification: Engine-side rod/seal untouched; mounting area protected from dirt.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove master
steps.instruction: Remove lever pivot bolt/nut, lever and bushing. Remove master holder and master, retaining paint-mark position and left-switch lead routing.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Remove old master kit
steps.instruction: Remove boot/pushrod, retaining ring and piston/spring/seals in diagram253 order, controlling spring release. Inspect body for cracks/damage and bore/kit for rust, scratches or wear; damaged master and kit must be replaced together.
steps.verification: Record master condition; no damaged bore reused.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Clean hydraulic parts
steps.instruction: Clean disconnected hose and master internals with fresh DOT4, never solvents. Clear blocked master fluid passages with compressed air. Inspect hose, reservoir and diaphragm; replace damaged parts. Discard drained cleaning fluid.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Install new master kit
steps.instruction: Lubricate internal kit parts with fresh DOT4. Fit new seals in diagram253 positions/orientations, then spring/piston, retaining ring, pushrod and boot in the illustrated order. Apply silicone grease at the marked pushrod surfaces and verify ring seating.
steps.verification: Record new seals and diagram-matched orientation/retention.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Refit master and lever
steps.instruction: Fit holder UP upward with its end at handlebar paint mark; restore switch lead through holder. Tighten upper holder bolt first, then lower, both9 Nm. Restore bushing and lever, lubricating marked locations with silicone grease; pivot bolt6 Nm and nut6 Nm.
steps.verification: Record holder alignment/sequence and lever torques.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Install replacement release cylinder
steps.instruction: Fit new mounting O-ring with silicone grease; retain washer in diagram257 position. Grease exposed pushrod-end contact. Seat replacement cylinder without trapping seal. Apply specified LOCTITE treatment to mounting bolts and tighten10 Nm.
steps.verification: Record new O-ring, washer position and10 Nm mounting torque.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Connect both hose ends
steps.instruction: Use two new copper washers per union. At master, white paint dot faces forward and aligns with body projection. At release, pipe touches its body stop as263. Tighten both union bolts30 Nm; steer both ways to verify hose clearance.
steps.verification: Record four washers, both stop orientations and30 Nm unions.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Fill to clutch baseline
steps.instruction: With reservoir top horizontal, fill fresh DOT4 to the exact baseline shown on100. Fit diaphragm; avoid overflow or water entry. Connect clear hose securely to release bleeder with outlet in catch container.
steps.verification: Fluid at clutch baseline; do not substitute brake minimum-mark rule.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Bleed the clutch
steps.instruction: Slowly squeeze lever several times, then fully squeeze and hold. Open bleeder; close before releasing lever. Repeat until bubbles disappear, keeping sufficient fluid in reservoir. If tiny bubbles persist, let fluid settle a few hours and repeat.
steps.verification: Record bubble-free fluid and firm lever response.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Close hydraulic circuit
steps.instruction: Tighten release bleeder5 Nm, refit its cap and restore clutch fluid baseline. Refit diaphragm and cap without overflow; cap screws1.5 Nm. Clean spills. Refit sprocket cover with both bolts7 Nm.
steps.verification: Record fluid baseline and closure torques.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Set lever position
steps.instruction: Push clutch lever forward while turning its adjusting bolt to desired reach, then tighten locknut5 Nm. Check free lever movement and hose clearance at both steering limits.
steps.verification: Record lever adjustment and routing check.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion

steps.title: Check clutch function
steps.instruction: Inspect all hydraulic connections and mounts for leakage/security. Verify normal clutch operation; soft or spongy lever requires further bleeding. Persistent slipping, drag or abnormal operation requires mechanical-clutch diagnosis.
steps.verification: Record no leaks and normal clutch operation; unresolved faults prevent completion.
steps.origin: Yamaha OEM service manual; original factual companion
